Fields: id, file, kind (hand|face|object), source (generated|licensed_dataset|own_photoshoot), generator {model, licence, prompt, seed}, dataset {name, licence, agreement}, consent (model release / synthetic: no real person), intended {emotion, intensity}, validation {raters, agreement, date}, status (draft|in_validation|approved|rejected).
